about: The V80 compute shell's dynamic region (pblock_slash, SLASH linker/slashkit/resources/base/compute/constraints/impl.xdc) per SLR, its sites counted by Vivado 2025.2 on b4e's opt checkpoint (11-07). Unequal: the static region owns most of SLR0. sites_per_lut converts placed LUTs to foldsim_degree's LUT sites: b4e's largest SLR group, 978,886 estimated sites placed as 672,695 LUTs (post-synth hierarchical utilization), the group that spilled over SLR2/SLR1 at 95 % of SLR2's LUTs. margin: the share of an SLR's LUTs a group may fill and still route at 200 MHz.
